Subject: DPO review
Date: Tuesday 3 November 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Owen Pritchard <owen.pritchard@oakleyrowe.example.test>

Owen,

Thank you for putting the assessment in front of the DPO.

You said the DPO will come back with comments within a fortnight, which I have noted.

Best,
Dom

expected.description: Owen Pritchard to return the DPO comments on the impact assessment
expected.evidenceQuote: You said the DPO will come back with comments within a fortnight, which I have noted.

notes: A fortnight resolved to fourteen days after the mail date.
